description: A message sent by a player, scoped to a specific context like a location, party, or another player.

text.description: The content of the chat message.

context.description: The context in which the message was sent. The presence of a field determines the scope. If null, it's global/realm chat.

locationRef.description: For local chat. A reference to the location where the message was sent.

partyRef.description: For party chat. A reference to the party the message is for.

recipientDid.description: For direct messages. The DID of the recipient.
